title: Melty launched today. Is it legit or malware?
author: GreatGhastly
selftext: Thinking it might be capitalizing on the recent decompiling hype, don't want to check it out yet until others have.

replies.author: Kamalen
replies.body: Wouldn't be the first company build malware, but it's more likely a company surfing on the trend
